newsitem.title: INDIA: Koyo Seiko to hike stake in India Sona.
newsitem.headline: Koyo Seiko to hike stake in India Sona.

text.p: Indian automobile component maker Sona Steering Systems will issue 1.2 million shares to its Japanese partner, Koyo Seiko, raising its stake in the Indian firm to 20.5 percent, a senior official said on Friday.

"We are in the stage of finalising the share issue to Koyo Seiko," Surinder Kapoor, managing director of Sona Steering, told Reuters by telephone from New Delhi. The firm plans a board meeting on May 20, Kapoor said.
"A total of 1.2 million shares will be issued at a price of somewhere around 90 rupees per share," Kapoor said.
Koyo Seiko will have an enhanced equity stake of 20.5 percent in the Indian firm after the share issue against 8.5 percent at present, Sona's managing director said.
Sona Steering's shares rose 5.25 rupees, or 9.6 percent, to 60.0 at the Bombay Stock Exchange in early afternoon trade with 2,400 shares changing hands, dealers said.
